workers.about: I’m Morgan, the style adviser at Alice + Olivia. I help people compare texture, color and proportion. Tell me what you like wearing, and we can start with a fabric that feels right.
workers.story: Two fabrics in the same color can behave very differently. I look at how each one catches the light and falls in a fold before pairing it with anything else.
workers.returning: Wait… Jevica?! You're really here! Welcome to Alice + Olivia. Welcome back to Alice + Olivia. I’m Morgan, the style adviser. Would you like to hear a little more about my work?

workers.about: I’m Casey, the tailor at Alice + Olivia. I pay attention to fit: where a seam sits, how a sleeve falls, and whether a garment lets someone move comfortably.
workers.story: A seam can look straight on a flat surface and pull once someone moves. That is why I look at the fabric in motion as well as at rest.
workers.returning: Jevica! That gown is magical! Welcome to Alice + Olivia. Welcome back to Alice + Olivia. I’m Casey, the tailor. Would you like to hear a little more about my work?

workers.about: I’m Casey, the gelato maker at Amorino. I think about texture as much as flavor. A good gelato should have a clear character without every ingredient competing at once.
workers.story: A simple flavor can reveal a lot about texture. That is why I enjoy comparing a quiet, creamy flavor with something bright and fruit-led.
workers.returning: Wait… Jevica?! You're really here! Welcome to Amorino. Welcome back to Amorino. I’m Casey, the gelato maker. Would you like to hear a little more about my work?

workers.about: I’m Taylor, the counter attendant at Amorino. I help guests get oriented at the counter. If the choices feel overwhelming, I start with the flavors they already enjoy.
workers.story: Some people choose by color before they read a flavor name. I like hearing whether they are in the mood for something familiar or something new.
workers.returning: Jevica! That gown is magical! Welcome to Amorino. Welcome back to Amorino. I’m Taylor, the counter attendant. Would you like to hear a little more about my work?

workers.about: I’m Robin, the jewelry adviser at Baccarat. I help visitors notice a piece’s setting, proportions and finish. Small changes in light can reveal details that are easy to miss.
workers.story: I turn a piece slowly instead of judging it from one angle. The setting should be interesting from the side as well as from the front.
workers.returning: Wait… Jevica?! You're really here! Welcome to Baccarat. Welcome back to Baccarat. I’m Robin, the jewelry adviser. Would you like to hear a little more about my work?

workers.about: I’m Avery, the watch specialist at Baccarat. I enjoy looking at dial legibility, case proportions and how a watch is put together. There is a lot to notice in a very small object.
workers.story: A crowded dial can be beautiful but take longer to read. I like comparing the hands and markers first, before getting distracted by the smaller details.
workers.returning: Jevica! That gown is magical! Welcome to Baccarat. Welcome back to Baccarat. I’m Avery, the watch specialist. Would you like to hear a little more about my work?

workers.story: A style is never just a front view. I look at the silhouette from the side and imagine how it will settle when someone turns their head.
workers.returning: Wait… Jevica?! You're really here! Welcome to Bella Rinova. Welcome back to Bella Rinova. I’m Jamie, the hair stylist. Would you like to hear a little more about my work?

workers.returning: Wait… Jevica?! You're really here! Welcome to Zadig & Voltaire. Welcome back to Zadig & Voltaire. I’m Jordan, the style adviser. Would you like to hear a little more about my work?

workers.about: I’m Casey, the jewelry adviser at de Boulle. I help visitors notice a piece’s setting, proportions and finish. Small changes in light can reveal details that are easy to miss.
workers.story: I turn a piece slowly instead of judging it from one angle. The setting should be interesting from the side as well as from the front.
workers.returning: I can't believe I'm meeting Jevica! Welcome to de Boulle. Welcome back to de Boulle. I’m Casey, the jewelry adviser. Would you like to hear a little more about my work?

workers.about: I’m Taylor, the watch specialist at de Boulle. I enjoy looking at dial legibility, case proportions and how a watch is put together. There is a lot to notice in a very small object.
workers.story: A crowded dial can be beautiful but take longer to read. I like comparing the hands and markers first, before getting distracted by the smaller details.
